subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should OpenClaw support automated moving-main npm snapshots under `dev`, or formally make `dev` git-only and reserve npm prereleases for versioned `alpha` and `beta` releases?
rationale: The missing behavior is proven, but source inspection cannot safely choose the trigger policy, immutable snapshot version scheme, provenance requirements, credential boundary, or intended relationship to the existing `alpha` channel.

options.title: Make dev git-only
options.body: Remove the conditional npm `dev` promise and retain versioned `alpha` and `beta` as the only npm prerelease channels.

options.title: Add secured dev snapshots
options.body: Define unique snapshot versions and a trusted moving-main workflow with provenance, approval boundaries, tests, and post-publish registry checks.

recommendation.title: Make dev git-only
recommendation.body: Remove the conditional npm `dev` promise and retain versioned `alpha` and `beta` as the only npm prerelease channels.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the dev channel, has the strongest sustained history on the npm release path, and already participated in this issue's review.
